scripts.stamper: npm run sync-ui-assets && npm run build -w ces-ui-kit && npm run build -w ces-stamper-ui && npm run gui -w ces-stamper -- --port 5002
scripts.ao: npm run sync-ui-assets && npm run gui -w ces-ao -- --port 5003
scripts.eo: npm run sync-ui-assets && cross-env EO_PORT=5004 npm run dev:eo -w ces-eo
scripts.muster: npm run sync-ui-assets && cd ces-muster && npm run dev
scripts.tester: cd ces-tester && npm run build && node bin/ces-tester.mjs run-m2
scripts.build:ao-ui: npm run build -w ces-ui-kit && npm run build -w ces-ao-ui
scripts.build:eo-ui: npm run build -w ces-ui-kit && npm run build -w ces-eo-ui
scripts.build:core: npm run build:shared && npm run build:stamper && npm run build:ao && npm run build:eo
scripts.pretest: npm run build:shared && npm run build:stamper
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:stamper && npm run test:eo && npm run test:ao && npm run test:ec
